arStrings.szText:
Every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"||]th{/c} {c_important}Flurry{/c} Cast siphons all Damage-Over-Time effects on any enemy it hits, dealing the total damage instantly and consuming it. 

Each unique consumption increases {c_important}Flurry's{/c} damage by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"||]{/c} seconds.
